what.text: This page follows refugees from Qatar in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 73 refugees from Qatar, and the United Kingdom hosted 46.6% of them.
After the United Kingdom, the largest hosts are the United States, Germany and Canada.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Qatar, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2008 to 2012 and 2024 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1994 at 49 refugees, and UNHCR reports no figure above zero for 2000.
The figure was at its highest, 123, at the end of 2012.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
